evidence.quote: The basic studies (first and second semesters) are taught in English. An obligatory German language course takes place in the first year (eight hours/week + intensive language classes of 40 hours/week during the semester breaks). The main studies (the third semester to the seventh semester) are taught in German.
Newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 € per semester.

notes: The programme's own page is the German version; the DAAD page provides English-taught profile details. Tuition is 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU/EEA students, as stated by the university-wide tuition fees page and confirmed by the DAAD page; this applies to this programme. The intakes are for the winter semester (deadline 28 September 2026) and summer semester (deadline 9 March, year not stated, so left as per quote). The application channel is uni-assist for recognition of foreign certificates; the actual application is submitted via the university's eCampus portal.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Un stage pratique préalable de 30 jours ouvrables dans une entreprise est recommandé pour ce programme.
note.en: A prior practical internship of 30 working days in a company is recommended for this programme.

evidence.quote: Ein Vorpraktikum in einem Unternehmen im Umfang von 30 Präsenztagen wird für den Studiengang empfohlen, um die industrielle Arbeitswelt in einem Betrieb kennenzulernen.

note.fr: Le programme est sans restriction d'admission, mais les documents doivent être vérifiés par Uni-Assist ou le Studienkolleg Konstanz avant la candidature.
note.en: The programme has no admission restriction, but documents must be reviewed by Uni-Assist or Studienkolleg Konstanz before applying.

evidence.quote: Der Studiengang Künstliche Intelligenz und industrielle Digitalisierung ist zulassungsfrei, d.h. Sie können sich für einen Studienplatz direkt einschreiben.
Without certificate recognition, your application will unfortunately not be considered.
